lyrics.ja: 勇気と愛が世界を救う
lyrics.romaji: Yuuki to Ai ga Sekai wo Sukuu
lyrics.en: Courage and love will save the world
lyrics.zh: 勇氣與愛拯救世界

lyrics.ja: 絶対いつか 出会えるはずなの
lyrics.romaji: Zettai Itsuka Deaeru Hazu na no
lyrics.en: Surely someday I'm bound to meet him
lyrics.zh: 總有一天一定能遇見

lyrics.ja: 沈む夕日に淋しく一人 こぶし握りしめる私
lyrics.romaji: Shizumu Yuuhi ni Sabishiku Hitori Kobushi Nigirishimeru Watashi
lyrics.en: Alone in the sinking sunset, I clench my fist
lyrics.zh: 在沉落的夕陽下孤單一人，緊握拳頭的我

lyrics.ja: 週休二日 しかもフレックス
lyrics.romaji: Shuukyuu Futsuka Shikamo Furekkusu
lyrics.en: Two days off a week, and flextime too
lyrics.zh: 週休二日，還是彈性工時

lyrics.ja: 相手はどこにでも いるんだから
lyrics.romaji: Aite ha Doko ni demo Iru n Da kara
lyrics.en: Because potential partners are everywhere
lyrics.zh: 對象到處都有

lyrics.ja: 今夜 飲み会 期待している
lyrics.romaji: Konya Nomikai Kitai Shite Iru
lyrics.en: Tonight's drinking party—I'm looking forward to it
lyrics.zh: 期待今晚的聚會

lyrics.ja: 友達の友達に
lyrics.romaji: Tomodachi no Tomodachi ni
lyrics.en: At a friend of a friend
lyrics.zh: 在朋友的朋友之中

lyrics.ja: 目立つには どうしたらいいの
lyrics.romaji: Medatsu ni ha Dou Shitara Ii no
lyrics.en: What should I do to stand out?
lyrics.zh: 該怎麼做才能引人注目

lyrics.ja: 一番の悩み
lyrics.romaji: Ichiban no Nayami
lyrics.en: It's my biggest worry
lyrics.zh: 這是我最大的煩惱

lyrics.ja: 性格良ければいい そんなの嘘だと思いませんか?
lyrics.romaji: Seikaku Yokereba Ii Sonna no Uso Da to Omoimasen ka?
lyrics.en: "A good personality is enough"—don't you think that's a lie?
lyrics.zh: 「個性好就夠了」你不覺得那是騙人的嗎？

lyrics.ja: Boy meets girl 幸せの予感 きっと誰かを感じてる
lyrics.romaji: Boy Meets Girl Shiawase no Yokan Kitto Dareka wo Kanjiteru
lyrics.en: Boy meets girl—a premonition of happiness, I'm surely sensing someone
lyrics.zh: Boy meets girl 幸福的預感，一定感覺到了某個人

lyrics.ja: Fall in love ロマンスの神様 この人でしょうか
lyrics.romaji: Fall in Love Romansu no Kamisama Kono Hito Deshou ka
lyrics.en: Fall in love—god of romance, is it this person?
lyrics.zh: Fall in love 愛情之神，就是這個人嗎

lyrics.ja: ノリと恥じらい 必要なのよ
lyrics.romaji: Nori to Hajirai Hitsuyou na no yo
lyrics.en: You need both playfulness and modesty
lyrics.zh: 需要投入感和羞澀感

lyrics.ja: 初対面の男の人って
lyrics.romaji: Shotaimen no Otoko no Hito tte
lyrics.en: When it comes to men I meet for the first time
lyrics.zh: 初次見面的男人

lyrics.ja: 年齢 住所 趣味に職業
lyrics.romaji: Nenrei Juusho Shumi ni Shokugyou
lyrics.en: Age, address, hobbies, and job
lyrics.zh: 年齡、住址、興趣和職業

lyrics.ja: さりげなく チェックしなくちゃ
lyrics.romaji: Sarigenaku Chekku Shinakucha
lyrics.en: I have to casually check them all
lyrics.zh: 得若無其事地確認一下

lyrics.ja: 待っていました 合格ライン
lyrics.romaji: Matte Imashita Goukaku Rain
lyrics.en: I've been waiting—passing line
lyrics.zh: 等好久了，及格線

lyrics.ja: 早くサングラス取って見せてよ
lyrics.romaji: Hayaku Sangurasu Totte Misete yo
lyrics.en: Hurry up and take off your sunglasses
lyrics.zh: 快點拿下太陽眼鏡讓我看看

lyrics.ja: 笑顔が素敵 真顔も素敵
lyrics.romaji: Egao ga Suteki Magao mo Suteki
lyrics.en: Your smile is lovely, your serious face is lovely too
lyrics.zh: 笑臉迷人，正經的臉也迷人

lyrics.ja: 思わず見とれてしまうの
lyrics.romaji: Omowazu Mitorete Shimau no
lyrics.en: I can't help but gaze in admiration
lyrics.zh: 忍不住看得入迷

lyrics.ja: 幸せになれるものならば
lyrics.romaji: Shiawase ni Nareru Mono Naraba
lyrics.en: If I can become happy
lyrics.zh: 如果能獲得幸福

lyrics.ja: 友情より愛情
lyrics.romaji: Yuujou yori Aijou
lyrics.en: I'd choose love over friendship
lyrics.zh: 比起友情更想要愛情

lyrics.ja: 「帰りは送らせて」と さっそくOK ちょっと信じられない
lyrics.romaji: 「Kaeri ha Okurasete」 to Sassoku OK Chotto Shinjirarenai
lyrics.en: "Let me take you home"—I said OK right away, I can hardly believe it
lyrics.zh: 「讓我送妳回家」我立刻答應，有點難以置信

lyrics.ja: Boy meets girl 恋してる瞬間 きっとあなたを感じてる
lyrics.romaji: Boy Meets Girl Koishiteru Shunkan Kitto Anata wo Kanjiteru
lyrics.en: Boy meets girl—the moment I fall in love, I'm surely feeling you
lyrics.zh: Boy meets girl 戀愛的瞬間，一定感覺到了你

lyrics.ja: Fall in love ロマンスの神様 願いをかなえて
lyrics.romaji: Fall in Love Romansu no Kamisama Negai wo Kanaete
lyrics.en: Fall in love—god of romance, grant my wish
lyrics.zh: Fall in love 愛情之神，請實現我的心願

lyrics.ja: Boy meets girl 恋する気持ち 何より素敵な宝物
lyrics.romaji: Boy Meets Girl Koisuru Kimochi Nani yori Suteki na Takaramono
lyrics.en: Boy meets girl—this feeling of love is the most wonderful treasure
lyrics.zh: Boy meets girl 戀愛的心情是最美好的寶物

lyrics.ja: Fall in love ロマンスの神様 どうもありがとう
lyrics.romaji: Fall in Love Romansu no Kamisama Doumo Arigatou
lyrics.en: Fall in love—god of romance, thank you so much
lyrics.zh: Fall in love 愛情之神，非常感謝

lyrics.ja: よくあたる星占いに そう言えば書いてあった
lyrics.romaji: Yoku Ataru Hoshi Uranai ni Sou Ieba Kaite Atta
lyrics.en: Come to think of it, the accurate horoscope said
lyrics.zh: 話說回來，那準確的星座運勢寫著

lyrics.ja: 今日 会う人と結ばれる
lyrics.romaji: Kyou Au Hito to Musubareru
lyrics.en: I'll be bound with the person I meet today
lyrics.zh: 今天會和遇見的人結緣

lyrics.ja: 今週も 来週も さ来週もずっと oh yeah!
lyrics.romaji: Konshuu mo Raishuu mo Saraishuu mo Zutto Oh Yeah!
lyrics.en: This week, next week, the week after, forever—oh yeah!
lyrics.zh: 這週、下週、下下週，一直如此 oh yeah！

lyrics.ja: Boy meets girl 土曜日 遊園地 一年たったら ハネムーン
lyrics.romaji: Boy Meets Girl Doyoubi Yuuenchi Ichinen Tattara Hanemuun
lyrics.en: Boy meets girl—Saturday at the amusement park, and after a year, a honeymoon
lyrics.zh: Boy meets girl 星期六去遊樂園，一年後度蜜月

lyrics.ja: Fall in love ロマンスの神様 感謝しています
lyrics.romaji: Fall in Love Romansu no Kamisama Kansha Shite Imasu
lyrics.en: Fall in love—god of romance, I'm so grateful
lyrics.zh: Fall in love 愛情之神，我心懷感謝

lyrics.ja: Boy meets girl いつまでも ずっとこの気持ちを忘れたくない
lyrics.romaji: Boy Meets Girl Itsu made mo Zutto Kono Kimochi wo Wasuretakunai
lyrics.en: Boy meets girl—I never want to forget this feeling
lyrics.zh: Boy meets girl 永遠都不想忘記這份心情

lyrics.ja: Fall in love ロマンスの神様 どうもありがとう
lyrics.romaji: Fall in Love Romansu no Kamisama Doumo Arigatou
lyrics.en: Fall in love—god of romance, thank you so much
lyrics.zh: Fall in love 愛情之神，非常感謝
